subject: par.secr.fit and models for multiple parameters

messages.author: 91bd4367f6044e8d
messages.subject: par.secr.fit and models for multiple parameters
parts:
Hi,

Whilst I can fit a model for one parameter at a time, par.secr.fit will not allow me to do the following:

base.args <- list(capthist = ch, mask = mask, trace = FALSE, CL = T, detectfn = 'HR')
args.Dsex.g0sex.sigmasex <- c(base.args, model = list(D ~ sex, g0 ~ sex, sigma ~ sex))
args.Dsex.g0sexb.sigmasex <- c(base.args, model = list(D ~ sex, g0 ~ sex + b, sigma ~ sex))
args.Dsex.g0sexbk.sigmasex <- c(base.args, model = list(D ~ sex, g0 ~ sex + bk, sigma ~ sex))
arglist <- list(sex = args.Dsex.g0sex.sigmasex, sex.b = args.Dsex.g0sexb.sigmasex, sex.bk = args.Dsex.g0sexbk.sigmasex)
fits.sex <- par.secr.fit(arglist, ncores = 3)

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) :
  3 nodes produced errors; first error: unused arguments (model1 = D ~ sex, model2 = g0 ~ sex, model3 = sigma ~ sex)

Is there an alternate way to code this for efficient fitting of multiple models?

Thanks once again,

Rebecca

messages.author: e14baef37a11434f
messages.subject: Re: par.secr.fit and models for multiple parameters
parts:
I think you want each model as an individual list perhaps? This general approach works for me:

secr.null <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~1, sigma~1), mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)
  
secr.t <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~t, sigma~1), mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)
  
secr.bk <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~bk, sigma~1), mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)

secr.sd <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~snowdepth, sigma~1), mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)

secr.bk.sd <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~bk + snowdepth, sigma~1), mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)

secr.t.bk <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~t + bk, sigma~1), mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)

secr.bait.bk <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~Bait + bk, sigma~1), sessioncov =SessionCov, mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)

secr.dna.bk <- list(capthist='guloCH', model = list(D~1, g0~DNA + bk, sigma~1), sessioncov=SessionCov, mask = "gulohablist", verify=FALSE)



########
##run in parallel
#######
detection.fits <- par.secr.fit (
  c('secr.null','secr.t', 'secr.bk','secr.sd', 'secr.bk.sd','secr.t.bk','secr.bait.bk','secr.dna.bk'),
  ncores = 8) ##755.575 minutes 
 
Cheers,
Clayton
